sloka: नंदन प्रतिमम् तु अन्यत् कुरवः उत्तरा इव ।सर्व काल फला यत्र पादपा मधुर स्रवाः ॥३-७३-७॥
transliteration: naṁdana pratimam tu anyat kuravaḥ uttarā iva ।sarva kāla phalā yatra pādapā madhura sravāḥ ॥3-73-7॥

translations.english: The trees in that garden with fruits of all seasons drip honey. Like the Chaitraratha garden (of Kubera), it bears fruits of all seasons.
